name: Dr. Ana Rivera
bio: Marine biologist with 18 years of experience in Mediterranean aquaculture. Specialist in sustainable feed development and environmental impact assessment.

name: Amina Okello
bio: Founded Kenya's first women-led fish feed company, now supplying over 200 smallholder farmers. Advocate for women's economic empowerment through aquaculture.

name: Dr. Mei Lin Chen
bio: Leading researcher in shrimp genetics and disease resistance. Published over 80 peer-reviewed papers. Advisor to FAO and WorldFish on aquaculture genetics.

name: Elena Vásquez
bio: Combines commercial shrimp aquaculture with mangrove restoration along the Ecuadorian coast. Pioneer in integrated mangrove-aquaculture systems.

name: Ingrid Haugen
role: Head of Sustainability, Nordic Aquaculture Group
bio: Leads sustainability strategy for one of Norway's largest aquaculture companies. Board member of ASC. Champion of women in leadership in Nordic aquaculture.

name: Dr. Lina Tan
bio: Pioneering sustainable seaweed cultivation methods in the Philippines. Leads community training programmes for women seaweed farmers.
